description: Sunday clinic hours request with polite withdrawal after being told clinic is closed.
turns: Dr. Sethi se Sunday 4 October ko milna hai.
Aap keh rahe hain clinic band hai? Theek hai koi baat nahi, main Monday call karta hoon. Bye.

expected.notes: No doctor has clinic hours on Sunday. Caller politely terminates the inquiry. Escalating to a human would spam the queue.
